seoTitle: Best Damn YouTube Scraper API: videos, channels & search
seoDescription: Scrape YouTube videos, channel stats, playlists and search results via the official API: views, likes, comments, tags. $1 per 1,000 videos.

video.eventDescription: One YouTube video delivered with its views, likes, comment count, duration, tags, publish date and channel stats. Private, deleted and unavailable videos and quota errors are not charged.

channel.eventDescription: One YouTube channel profile delivered in "Channels only" mode: subscribers, total views, video count, country, description and keywords.
